units.title: Introduction
topics: 1.2. Introduction to Elements of Landscape Design:  Plants and Vegetation  Hardscape Elements  Water Features Landscape Architecture Course Code: 4355006

1.3. Climatic effect of landscaping.  Temperature Regulation  Wind Regulation  Microclimate Modification  Stormwater Management  Air Quality Improvement  Biodiversity and Habitat Creation  Energy Efficiency
uos: 1.a. Apply understanding of landscape design components to analyse and evaluate existing landscapes.
1.b. Understand the basic elements and features of landscape design and explain their uses
1.c. Appreciate environment/climate requirements on landscape designing.  Structures and Features  Uses of the various landscape elements

units.title: Landscape Typologies
topics: 2.1. Introduction to Historical landscape architectural styles i. Indian Orchard System ii. Mughal Landscape iii. Oriental Landscape iv. Roman Landscape v. French Landscape vi. English Landscape vii. Modern Landscape
uos: 2.a. Enlist the various components of Landscape architectural styles.

units.title: Remodelling to Character Bungalow
topics: 3.1. Floor plan with complete Site layout should including building units, roads and landscaped areas drawn clearly without rendering.
3.2. Landscape details to understand the layout in its totality.
uos: 3.a. Develop Landscape design model of a selected a residential building unit/s.
3.b. Draw all the drawings, sketch to a suitable scale.

units.title: Design of Landscape for a Character Bungalow
topics: 4.1. Development of sketches showing spatial relationships and interactions to an appropriate scale.
4.2. Development of site layout with road network and landscaping.
4.3. Development of elevations and sections with respect to activities and usage of different spaces.
uos: 4.a. Design hard and soft landscape features as per requirements. 4b.Develop the design using the components and elements of landscape architecture discussed afore.

units.title: Presentation Drawings
topics: 5.1. Plans and sectional elevations with detailed rendering showing all the components and elements of landscape e.g. Vegetation, garden furniture, hard and soft landscapes, water bodies, etc. as per the design.
uos: 5.a. Prepare all necessary Plans - - fully rendered with colour scheme, material, and description of species used. 5b.Prepare 3D views/ sketches to explain the elements & designs.
